q: How would you handle working with colleagues from many different cultural backgrounds?
a:
I believe working with colleagues from different cultural backgrounds is a great opportunity to learn and grow. I always show respect for different perspectives and try to understand cultural differences.

In my experience, clear communication and empathy are very important. I always listen carefully and communicate in a clear and respectful way.

I also believe that diversity makes a team stronger, and I enjoy working in an international environment where we can learn from each other.
